title: The caves
content: If you ever find yourself in the environment around mallworld, there is a green cavey area that goes to a subterranean forest. I would very much like to hear from those who have been here or plan to go, I often find other sentient dreamers down there, or people who seem to be sentient and trapped there. If you go too deep there is a demonic mansion that leads to some kind of obelisk of sacrifice at the border between the beneath and I'm assuming hell. Anyway would love to hear some reports
